answer: Each epoch, every identity receives the same ocean-crossing route task with one planted ripple: a single impossible detail, a yarrow waypoint placed mid-water or a tide running uphill, unique to that identity. Standing requires flagging your own anomaly before solving; solving past it voids the answer. A farm's shared pipeline solves the common task once and re-skins it, so its clones either miss every planted flaw or must run genuine per-identity verification on each copy. Checking stops being shareable: the flaw differs per identity, so one careful pass cannot cover a hundred names.
